description: This file defines a validation rule class for Buzz video links within the OrangeHRM Buzz API module. It includes class inheritance, a validate method, and references to external DTO and core validation rule classes.

classes.name: BuzzVideoLinkValidationRule
classes.description: A validation rule for checking the validity of Buzz video URLs, extending the abstract rule class.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input as a proper Buzz video URL by creating a BuzzEmbeddedURL object and checking its validity.
